title: Camarones con Chupe de Mariscos
description: A Peruvian-style seafood stew with succulent shrimp and a flavorful chupe de mariscos sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chupe de mariscos and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fish stock, shrimp broth powder, and ají amarillo paste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Add the peeled and deveined shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
